description: This file declares the exported API functions for the Beep Env Controller Object used in the BSP Execution Environment Plane Implementation (BEEP). It contains function prototypes for creating, removing, enrolling objects, and initializing the Env Controller, indicating its role as part of the system's interface definitions.

methods.name: BeepCreateEnvController
methods.description: Creates an environment controller object with given container, owner, and reserved contexts.

methods.name: BeepEcoCreate
methods.description: Creates the Beep Env Controller object with specified contexts.

methods.name: BeepEcoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary objects into the Env Controller.
